name: Cash to Cash Payments for WooCommerce
author: tillpaid

sections.description:
Cash to Cash Payments for WooCommerce allows stores on WooCommerce to accept MTN Mobile Money payments without requiring any KYC or Operator API.

Customers simply transfer the payment using MTN Mobile Money, enter the transaction reference, and upload their payment proof directly during checkout.

The merchant receives the payment directly on their own Mobile Money account.

Free Features

  • Accept MTN Mobile Money payments.
  • Cash2Cash payment method.
  • Custom payment instructions.
  • Configurable merchant name and phone number.
  • Transaction reference.
  • WooCommerce order integration.
  • Order status set to “On Hold”.
  • Translation ready.

Upgrade to Standard Version

Update to Standard version adds advanced features to simplify payment management, including:

  • Faster payment validation.
  • Payment proof upload (JPG, PNG, PDF).
  • Progress Bar for the client
  • UX Design for more conversion
  • Improved checkout experience.
  • Additional configuration options.
  • Priority support.
  • Continuous updates.

Upgrade to Ultimate Version

Ultimate version is designed for professional merchants and agencies.

It includes everything from Free Version plus:

  • Advanced payment automation.
  • OCR-based payment proof recognition.
  • Intelligent fraud detection and payment scoring.
  • Premium WooCommerce features.
  • Lifetime updates.
  • Priority technical support.

Learn more:

https://tillpaid.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
  4. Enable MoMoPaid.
  5. Configure your Mobile Money number and beneficiary information.
  6. Save your settings.
sections.faq:
Does Cash to Cash Payments for WooCommerce require an MTN API?

No. Cash to Cash Payments for WooCommerce works with a direct payment workflow and does not require an API.

Which countries are supported?

The plugin can be used wherever MTN Mobile Money is available.

Does the free version include OCR verification?

No. OCR payment verification is available in Ultimate version only.

Where can I get support?

Support and documentation are available on:

https://tillpaid.com
